items.title: We had the origin of more than 200 tomato products tested. The results were shocking
items.description: One of Australia's biggest tomato brands and two major supermarkets are selling products that exclusive forensic testing shows have misleading labelling.

items.title: Kogan running 'clone' website selling same products at higher prices
items.description: An ABC investigation has discovered that leading online retailer Kogan is operating a second website called Exclusive Brands, selling the same products with large price hikes.

items.title: The test coming to all mobile devices and what to know before it lands
items.description: Australia is about to get its first taste of a new nationwide emergency warning system, where millions of devices across the country are expected to sound off simultaneously later today.

items.title: Tunnel workers repeatedly exposed to high silica dust levels
items.description: Tunnel workers on some of Australia's most prominent infrastructure projects were repeatedly exposed to levels of silica dust far beyond the workplace standard, previously secret reports reveal.

items.title: Found lifeless in the water, Vicky is now a swimming medallist
items.description: Victoria Belando Nicholson was a baby when she was pulled lifeless from the water after falling from a refugee boat. Now she's a swimming bronze medallist for Australia.

items.title: Live: King Cam reigns supreme as distance queen Pallister dominates
items.description: Cameron McEvoy adds Commonwealth Games gold to his Olympics and World Championships title on another stunning golden day for Australia. Follow live.

items.title: Victorian premier facing leadership challenge this week
items.description: Factional convenors from both the right and left of the party room met on Sunday night to discuss whether Jacinta Allan still had the support of a majority of caucus. The ABC understands they agreed she did not.

items.title: Alleged attacker at Berlin Pride event shot dead by police
items.description: A nationwide manhunt in Germany ends as details about the suspected attacker, Abdul B, who was born in Germany in 2005, begin to emerge.

items.title: Luke Bateman earned $400K a year and gambled away every cent
items.description: Luke Bateman was 19 and living out his NRL dream when he went to a casino for the first time. It kick-started a gambling addiction, and he retired from sport $250,000 in debt.

items.title: Kumanjayi White's family sues for answers on police probe
items.description: The family of Kumanjayi White has launched legal action seeking answers over who made the decision not to pursue charges against the police officers involved in the 24-year-old's death.

items.title: Refugee searching for rental home rejected more than 100 times
items.description: Advocacy groups say migrants can help address workforce shortages but more should be done to help them access affordable housing.

items.title: Labor's command and control culture may come with a cost
items.description: Anthony Albanese's tightly managed Labor conference showcased discipline over dissent. But could shutting down public debate carry risks beyond the party room?

items.title: How student 'cockroaches' brought down a pillar of Modi's government
items.description: Narendra Modi's government has a history of taking a tough stance on protesters, but with millions of India's young people at the gates, something finally had to give.

items.title: Hopes US and Iran will return to negotiating table after lull in hostilities
items.description: Iran has passed another night without US air strikes, as Washington pauses a war nearing its fifth month and reports emerge that concerns over dwindling munitions are restraining plans for further escalation.

items.title: AI chatbots might feel supportive, but do they give good relationship advice?
items.description: While the accessibility and "judgement-free zone" of AI chatbots can be attractive when seeking relationship advice, experts warn there are risks you need to be aware of.

items.title: Travel from a Transylvanian village to Madagascar with these films
items.description: From bullfighting in Madagascar to swimming the English Channel in Jersey, catch up on every week eight film from Race Around the World.

items.title: History quiz: Test your smarts on everything from Apple to Aretha Franklin
items.description: Also in this week's quiz, which member of the British royal family won an Olympic medal in 2012? And how familiar are you with Beatrix Potter characters?

items.title: Inside Hobart council's 'snack saga' and why the police are involved
items.description: Hobart's deputy lord mayor has admitted to and apologised for taking snacks and drinks from a council lounge over several years, but some of her fellow councillors won't let the matter die.

items.title: Live: ASX set to open higher after tech stocks dumped on Wall Street
items.description: Wall Street eked out a marginal gain despite the continued retreat of tech stocks, while the ASX is priced to open higher. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: There's a chance your local MP doesn't live in your neighbourhood. Does that matter?
items.description: The Secret Harbour by-election in Western Australia – in which none of the key candidates live in the electorate – has raised an interesting question: should MPs live in the area they represent?

items.title: Woman dies from head-on crash with man fleeing after stabbing partner
items.description: The woman was driving on a highway in northern Tasmania when she was involved in a head-on collision with a man from Western Australia, who police say had been driving erratically after stabbing his partner.

items.title: Family flee 'targeted' arson attack in north-east Melbourne
items.description: Police are investigating an alleged targeted arson attack on a home in Mill Park overnight, which forced a family to flee through their backyard.

items.title: Hotel 'crisis' looms for new Sydney airport just months ahead of opening
items.description: The lack of hotel space for the soon-to-be opened Western Sydney Airport (WSI) has been flagged as a major issue.

items.title: Piastri blasts '****ing stupid' backmarker, Norris wins Hungarian GP
items.description: Oscar Piastri retired from the Formula 1 Hungarian Grand Prix, won by his teammate Lando Norris, but not before he blasted a "stupid" backmarker and slammed his team for a poor strategy at the Hungaroring.

items.title: 'Don't know how I do it': Pogačar claims fifth Tour de France title
items.description: Tadej Pogačar confirms his status as one of cycling's all-time greats after winning a record-equalling fifth Tour de France title in emphatic style.
